summary: Frontend-only QA of the new 3-step tournament engine on /admin/t/<tid>/partite. Created fresh tournament 'QA Motore UI 1790850345' (tid 6abe352caa95059b437486af, formula 'Gironi + fase finale', 8 squadre / 2 gironi / 2 qualificate, dates 2026-12-12 → 2026-12-13, category defaulted to 2015). All critical flows verified end-to-end. STEP 1 Gironi: steps bar renders with matches-step-gironi active, state badge starts missing then becomes 'Gironi configurati' after confirming the random preview; groups-create-placeholders produced 8 placeholder teams ('Completa i gironi con segnaposto (1)' label — see note); groups-distribute-random opened groups-preview-dialog, groups-preview-repeat changed the preview text, groups-preview-confirm filled both gironi 4/4; group-team-move-<id> moved Squadra 3 from A→B (5/3) and back (4/4). Rename worked (team-edit-dialog: 'Squadra 2' → 'Squadra 2 QA'); linking club 'Urbetevere QA' (created via Società) via team-edit-club displayed the team as 'Urbetevere QA 2015' (bold, non-italic). STEP 2 Calendario: calendar-tools visible; calendar-generate-button (tutti i gironi) created 12 matches, calendar-no-conflicts badge green, calendar-publish-button '(12)'; matches-view-toggle switched to calendar-grid with 12 calendar-cell-<id>; clicking a cell opened match-edit-dialog, changing field saved → toast 'Gara aggiornata'. Conflict detection: setting a 2nd match to same kickoff+field as another produced a native confirm 'Conflitto rilevato: Campo 2 occupato da 2 gare alle 08:30 del 2026-12-12 Salvare comunque la modifica?' which was dismissed; calendar-conflicts-badge then showed '1 conflitti'. Publish 12 → toast '12 gare pubblicate', button removed, state badge → 'Calendario pubblicato'. Bulk shift_minutes +35 (scope date, 2026-12-12) shifted first match from 08:30 → 09:05; a subsequent -35 restored it to 08:30 (conflict confirms were accepted since bulk re-places matches). Generate scope 'Solo Girone A': regenerated 6 draft Girone A matches; total match-edit remained 12 (6 draft + 6 published Girone B); publish re-appeared as '(6)' and was clicked to republish. STEP 3 Fasi finali: finals-state 'Non ancora generata · in attesa dei gironi', finals-empty 'Non ancora generate.'; finals-structure-button created 2 semifinali ('1ª Girone A – 2ª Girone B' and '1ª Girone B – 2ª Girone A' at 12-13 08:30, Campi 1/2). finals-resolve-button triggered confirm '12 gare dei gironi non sono ancora ufficiali…' which was dismissed (not forced). finals-edit-<id> on a semifinal opened match-edit-dialog, field change saved with toast 'Gara aggiornata'; state badge → 'Fase finale configurata'. Regression: on /admin/t/6a9b5b045d9e0985643d0a9f/partite?step=calendario the list of 155 matches is rendered with 155 match-edit pencils (steps bar visible), Gironi step shows 62 group-* testids (8 competitions as groups with real teams), Fasi finali shows 'Questo torneo non prevede una fase finale (formula campionato)'; /referti does NOT render the matches-steps bar (correct, reports mode); public /tornei/la-serie-a-dei-bambini/partite renders the full giornata grid with real logos. The 3 production tournaments were NOT modified; a disposable 'QA Motore UI' tournament and a disposable 'Urbetevere QA' club were created and left behind for inspection.

ui_bugs.issue: Transient toast 'Torneo non trovato' appears on first navigation to /admin/t/<tid>/partite on a brand-new tournament even though the current tournament IS loaded and the board renders correctly after. Likely a stale/parallel GET /api/public/tornei/<slug or id> returning 404 while the slug is being computed. Non-blocking but noisy.

integration_issues.issue: The 'Modifiche massive' Applica button piggybacks on the same per-match conflict confirm path (window.confirm 'Conflitto rilevato… Applicare comunque?'), which means a bulk run that produces any overlap will stop on the first match and ask once per occurrence instead of a single aggregated prompt. Current flow still works (dialog accept-all applies all), but UX could aggregate conflicts and ask once.

When the conflict confirm is dismissed, the match-edit-dialog stays open with the overlay — correct behaviour, but any subsequent click on the main page (e.g., Publish) is intercepted until the user explicitly presses Annulla. Minor; could auto-close on dismiss or clearly hint it.

issues: The placeholder button label used in the spec says 'Completa i gironi con segnaposto (8)' when 8 are missing, but on a tournament whose Impostazioni already registered the planned teams the number can be '(1)' (the UI uses needed = teams_total - current). This matches code, just differs from the test spec wording.

action_items: Investigate the transient 'Torneo non trovato' toast on /admin/t/<newly-created-tid>/partite first load — likely a 404 from a secondary tournament fetch while the slug/id key is still null. Non-blocking.
(nice-to-have) Aggregate 'Conflitto rilevato' prompts in bulk mode into a single confirmation listing all affected matches instead of one per overlapping match.

(nice-to-have) When the user dismisses the native 'Conflitto rilevato' confirm, auto-close match-edit-dialog or show an inline conflict banner so Publish / other actions aren't blocked by an overlay the user may think is closed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend groups API responses (board, placeholders, distribute/preview, matches/bulk, finals) all behaved correctly from the frontend's viewpoint — 12-match generate, publish, bulk shift, structure, resolve-with-force-confirm all round-tripped cleanly.

Random placeholder distribution on 8 teams / 2 groups occasionally produces 5-3 instead of 4-4 (observed once during the run). If strict balance is a product requirement, the algorithm in /backend/app/routers/groups.py distribute_preview should enforce ceil/floor caps per group.

window.confirm is used for destructive confirmations (conflict override, regenerate calendar, resolve-with-force). Consistent with the rest of the app, but harder to style and screen-read. Consider switching to a Dialog with explicit test-ids if a11y testing is required.
Steps bar correctly hidden in mode=reports (/referti) and shown in mode=matches (/partite). Good role separation.
seed_data_creation: Created tournament 'QA Motore UI 1790850345' (tid 6abe352caa95059b437486af) and club 'Urbetevere QA' (id 6abe369aaa95059b437486e4). These are QA leftovers; safe to purge. The 3 seeded production tournaments (la-serie-a-dei-bambini, torneo-degli-amici, future-cup-weekend) were NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The default category in the New Tournament wizard is '2015' (not '2016' as the review request's example implies), so the group testids are group-2015-girone-a / group-2015-girone-b for this QA tournament; use /api/tournaments/{tid}/board or page.evaluate to read the actual code before targeting a specific one. Conflict and regenerate dialogs are native window.confirm — register page.on('dialog', …) BEFORE the triggering click, and know that dismissing the conflict confirm in match-edit leaves the Dialog overlay in place, so remember to click 'Annulla' to close it before clicking other page controls. Bulk shift also pipes through the same conflict confirm per occurrence. Publish button disappears from the DOM once all drafts are published, so test for its absence rather than disabled state.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested flows behave as specified. Only the three LOW-priority UX observations above are worth main-agent attention.
